project.name: moonlightOS
project.description: S-mode RISC-V microkernel with U-mode userspace, spec-first and partially verified in Isabelle/HOL. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.

layers.name: Userspace servers + ABI
layers.description: Frozen v1 ABI headers, moonlight lib, mem/sched/vfs servers, shell, adminvm/qrexec/firewall/net/vault/cryptblk/gui

layers.name: Drivers + libc
layers.description: Driver compartments (uart/plic/timer/rtc/power/block/vga/virtio_net) and freestanding rv64 libc (~62 src files) + examples

layers.name: Tests + verification
layers.description: 30 host-sim tests, tools/verify.sh 4 stages, run_qemu.sh smoke, Makefiles, CI workflows

layers.name: Spec + proofs + docs
layers.description: V2_DESIGN live spec, ARCHITECTURE/BUILD, Isabelle V2_A-D + Qubes_A-D (390 lemmas, 0 axioms), historical v1 docs quarantined

tour.title: Start: README + V2_DESIGN
tour.description: Boot model (OpenSBI->S-mode kernel->U-mode ping-pong), BUILT markers in V2_DESIGN section 9

tour.title: Kernel entry + memory
tour.description: start.S hart0-only, kboot.c Sv39 U-bit tables, satp, SBI console/timer, linker.ld layout gate

tour.title: Traps + scheduler + IPC
tour.description: trap.S u_enter/sret, pick_next lowest-Runnable, SEND/RECV/NOTIFY/WAIT rendezvous, fault containment

tour.title: Caps + ELF + Qubes policy
tour.description: caps.h 40 frames/32 slots, elf.c W^X checks, qube.h labels, qrexec/AdminVM/firewall/net/vault/cryptblk/gui chain

tour.title: Userspace + verification
tour.description: ABI headers, servers, drivers, libc, tests host-sim, verify.sh 4 stages, QEMU smoke markers
